artifacts.content:
All 4 tests pass. Two bugs, two minimal edits:

- **`lib/cart.mjs`** — `cartTotal` summed only `item.price`, dropping quantity. It now sums `lineTotal(item)` (reusing the correct `price * qty` helper from `lib/pricing.mjs`, which was already right and untouched).
- **`lib/discount.mjs`** — `applyDiscount(200, 10)` returned `190` because it subtracted the percent as a flat amount. Now it subtracts `(total * percent) / 100`, so `200 - 10% = 180` and `50 - 0% = 50`.
